title: Order intake: accept each order exactly one time in our system (sample)
summary: Orders arrive over HTTP, are stored once, and an ERP worker sends them on later. This is a synthetic test pack.

glossary.meaning: Small pieces of code Azure runs for you.

main.name: API Management + Function
main.text: Checks and stores each order once

flow.text: The shop gets 202 with the order ID after the order is stored.

prerequisites: An Azure test subscription (no production data)
unknowns: The ERP's real error codes (sample codes are used).
not_used: Logic Apps: the intake must answer within one HTTP call.

IMP-003.where: Your code editor, then Azure portal > Function App
actions: Run the tests: python -m pytest function_app/tests.
Deploy only through your approved pipeline.
IMP-003.if_it_fails: Read the failing test name; it says which rule broke. Fix the code, not the test.

actions: Write the ERP worker using the sample error codes.
Replace the sample codes when the ERP team sends the real ones.

docs.title: Service Bus message sessions and scheduling

IMP-005.if_it_fails: Check the dead-letter queue for the reason, fix it, and replay with a new message ID.

walkthrough: It is stored and the shop gets 202 with O-1.
The shop sends O-1 again: same answer, nothing new stored.

troubleshooting.fix: Send the order ID in the request.
